extra_quotes: All measurements come from one DevEBox with one Board A and one Board B, taken in Karachi on 5 November 2026 over about two hours, at a room temperature that was not recorded.
The raw samples were captured with zirah capture, which asks the firmware for unconditioned ADC values, and assessed with NIST’s own SP 800-90B tool.
I make no claim that Zirah resists side-channel or fault attacks, and the evidence would not support one.
The entropy results describe one board, one transistor, one session and one supply.
